suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as bleeding mediated disease complication. Require documented uterine fibroids with clinically relevant abnormal/heavy uterine bleeding and separately documented iron deficiency and/or anemia. Do not infer anemia from asymptomatic fibroids. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Uterine Fibroids and Anemia (Iron Deficiency, Sickle Cell, Aplastic)
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes

Resolution of the publication guard: Require documented uterine fibroids with clinically relevant abnormal/heavy uterine bleeding and separately documented iron deficiency and/or anemia. Do not infer anemia from asymptomatic fibroids.
